answers.core: This potentially has a wide application wherever audio samples need to be timed exactly.  It should just be an option that's always available, just like the [AudioStreamPlaybackResampled.mix()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/db76de5de8a415b29be4c7dd84b99bd0fe260822/servers/audio/audio_stream.cpp#L151), which is already non-trivial in its implementation.
answers.workaround: No.  It would need to be a compiled AudioStream plugin, not as script.
